meta.name: English
boot.version: quantum computer simulator for learning · v0.1
boot.ready: System ready. You have a quantum register of 2 qubits, both in |0>.
boot.hint: Type 'help' to see what you can do, or 'lesson' to start learning.
help.title: QubitForge commands
help.more: Type 'help <command>' for details, e.g. 'help cx'. Angles accept pi: rx pi/2 0
cmd.qreg: Create a register of n qubits (all in |0>), or show the current one
cmd.reset: Reset all qubits to |0> and clear the circuit
cmd.state: Show the state: amplitudes and probabilities
cmd.probs: Show only the probability of each outcome
cmd.bloch: Bloch sphere coordinates and entanglement of a qubit
cmd.circuit: Draw the circuit built so far
cmd.measure: Measure a qubit (or all): the state collapses
cmd.run: Repeat the experiment many times (default 1024) without collapsing
cmd.save: Save the circuit to a .qf file
cmd.load: Run the commands of a .qf file
cmd.lesson: List lessons, or read lesson n
cmd.example: List ready-made circuits, or load one
cmd.explain: Toggle a short explanation after every gate
cmd.lang: Show or change the interface language
gate.y: Rotates 180° around the Y axis of the Bloch sphere.
gate.z: Flips the phase of |1> (|1> becomes -|1>), leaves |0> alone.
gate.h: Hadamard: turns |0> into an equal superposition of |0> and |1>.
gate.s: Phase of 90° on |1> (square root of Z).
gate.sdg: Inverse of S: phase of -90° on |1>.
gate.t: Phase of 45° on |1> (square root of S).
gate.tdg: Inverse of T: phase of -45° on |1>.
gate.rx: Rotation by any angle around the X axis.
gate.ry: Rotation by any angle around the Y axis.
gate.rz: Rotation by any angle around the Z axis (changes the phase).
gate.cx: CNOT: if the control is |1>, flips the target. Creates entanglement.
gate.cy: Controlled-Y: applies Y to the target if the control is |1>.
gate.cz: Controlled-Z: flips the phase only when both qubits are |1>.
gate.ch: Controlled-Hadamard: applies H to the target if the control is |1>.
gate.cp: Controlled phase: applies a phase to |1> if the control is |1>.
gate.ccx: Toffoli: flips the target only if both controls are |1>.
gate.swap: Swaps the state of two qubits.
qreg.info: Register: {n} qubits (q0..q{last}). Maximum: {max}. Use 'qreg <n>' to change.
state.header: amplitude            state   probability   (|q{last}...q0>, q0 on the right)
bloch.pure: Pure state: this qubit is not entangled; it sits on the sphere surface.
bloch.entangled: Mixed: this qubit is entangled with others, so alone it has no definite state (inside the sphere).
example.hint: Load one with 'example <name>', for example 'example bell'.
example.grover: Grover search on 2 qubits: finds |11> in a single step.
example.qft: Quantum Fourier transform on 3 qubits (starting from |101>).
example.superdense: Superdense coding: sends 2 classical bits using 1 qubit (message 11).
quit.bye: Shutting down the quantum register. Goodbye!
err.bad_angle: '{text}' is not a valid angle. Examples: 1.57, pi/2, 3*pi/4.
err.bad_qubit: '{token}' is not a qubit. Use a number (0, 1, ...) or 'all'.
err.qubit_range: Qubit {q} does not exist (you have q0..q{last}).
err.qubit_dup: The qubits must all be different.
err.qreg_range: The number of qubits must be between 1 and {max}.
err.shots_range: Choose a number of runs between 1 and {max}.
err.exists: '{path}' already exists: pick another name (nothing was overwritten).
err.unknown_example: No example called '{name}'. Type 'example' for the list.
err.no_lesson: No lesson number {n}. Type 'lesson' for the list.
err.depth: Files loaded from other files are nested too deeply.
